verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's pricing page lists "Multivariate and A/B Testing" as a product feature, and its open/click-rate reports measure engagement with subject lines and content. However, nothing in the pack documents how tests are set up or that a winner is automatically chosen from real engagement. Missing for 10: documentation of subject-line vs content variant testing, automatic winner selection based on opens/clicks/revenue, test configuration details such as sample size and duration, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement

citations.quote: Your Mailchimp tracking reports include open and click rates, which measure your recipients' engagement with your subject lines and email content.
